title: A free AI model is winning over developers. And nobody knows whose servers it runs on
summary: An anonymous model called Ox Alpha appeared on OpenRouter last week, free to use with a million-token context window, and developers have been impressed. OpenRouter’s own listing says prompts and completions are retained by the unidentified provider.
